tv_wonder_roll_next_slot_from_priority_deck_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_unique_has_any_feasible_proposal_trigger = yes }
		tv_wonder_unique_roll_random_feasible_proposal_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_generic_has_any_feasible_proposal_trigger = yes }
		tv_wonder_generic_roll_random_feasible_proposal_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_wonder_copy_sacred_mountain_survey_from_location_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_scale_competence value = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site.var:tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_scale_competence }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_logistics_competence value = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site.var:tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_logistics_competence }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_organization_competence value = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site.var:tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_organization_competence }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_complete value = 1 }
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_active
		tv_wonder_set_io_survey_progress_effect = { value = 100 }
		tv_wonder_update_construction_tiers_from_competence_effect = yes
	}
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_copy_completed_survey_from_location_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 1
			scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = { has_variable = tv_wonder_surveyed_sacred_mountain }
		}
		tv_wonder_copy_sacred_mountain_survey_from_location_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 2
			scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = { has_variable = tv_wonder_surveyed_triumphal_axis }
		}
		tv_wonder_copy_triumphal_axis_survey_from_location_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 3
			scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = { has_variable = tv_wonder_surveyed_great_port }
		}
		tv_wonder_copy_great_port_survey_from_location_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 4
			scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = { has_variable = tv_wonder_surveyed_giant_necropolis }
		}
		tv_wonder_copy_giant_necropolis_survey_from_location_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 5
			scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = { has_variable = tv_wonder_surveyed_great_lighthouse }
		}
		tv_wonder_copy_great_lighthouse_survey_from_location_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 6
			scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = { has_variable = tv_wonder_surveyed_hydraulic_workshop }
		}
		tv_wonder_copy_hydraulic_workshop_survey_from_location_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 7
			scope:tv_wonder_selected_survey_site = { has_variable = tv_wonder_surveyed_mining_city }
		}
		tv_wonder_copy_mining_city_survey_from_location_effect = yes
	}

tv_wonder_mechanics_apply_survey_site_preference_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 1

		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus value = var:tv_wonder_survey_site.development }
		clamp_variable = { name = tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus min = 0 max = 100 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus multiply = 0.1 }
		tv_wonder_change_all_survey_competence_target_effect = { value = var:tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus }
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus
		tv_wonder_change_scale_competence_target_effect = { value = 100 }
		tv_wonder_change_logistics_competence_target_effect = { value = 20 }
		tv_wonder_change_organization_competence_target_effect = { value = 20 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 136
			tv_wonder_survey_site_selected_trigger = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= { is_port = yes } }
		tv_wonder_change_all_survey_competence_target_effect = { value = 15 }
		}
		tv_wonder_change_scale_competence_target_effect = { value = 100 }
		tv_wonder_change_logistics_competence_target_effect = { value = 20 }
		tv_wonder_change_organization_competence_target_effect = { value = 20 }
	}
	else_if = {

			var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 137
			tv_wonder_survey_site_selected_trigger = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_site_preference_bonus value = var:tv_wonder_survey_site.development }

tv_wonder_mechanics_start_survey_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:target
			scope:target = { NOT = { tv_wonder_location_has_any_wonder_project_building_trigger = yes } }
		}
		tv_wonder_clear_current_survey_effect = yes
		scope:target = { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_selected_survey_site }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_site value = scope:target }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_stage value = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = { tv_wonder_selected_survey_already_cached_trigger = yes }
			tv_wonder_copy_completed_survey_from_location_effect = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_active value = 1 }
			tv_wonder_prepare_survey_competence_targets_effect = yes
			tv_wonder_set_io_survey_progress_effect = { value = 0 }
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_complete_survey_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_survey_active_trigger = yes }
		clamp_variable = { name = tv_wonder_scale_competence min = 0 max = 100 }
		clamp_variable = { name = tv_wonder_logistics_competence min = 0 max = 100 }
		clamp_variable = { name = tv_wonder_organization_competence min = 0 max = 100 }
		tv_wonder_update_construction_tiers_from_competence_effect = yes
		tv_wonder_store_survey_on_location_effect = yes
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_complete value = 1 }
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_active
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_survey_speed
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_scale_competence_target
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_logistics_competence_target
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_organization_competence_target
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_scale_competence_monthly_gain
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_logistics_competence_monthly_gain
		remove_variable = tv_wonder_organization_competence_monthly_gain
		tv_wonder_set_io_survey_progress_effect = { value = 100 }
		if = {
			limit = { tv_wonder_survey_site_selected_trigger = yes }
			var:tv_wonder_survey_site ?= { save_scope_as = tv_wonder_event_location }
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_competence_average value = var:tv_wonder_scale_competence }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_competence_average add = var:tv_wonder_logistics_competence }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_competence_average add = var:tv_wonder_organization_competence }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_survey_competence_average divide = 3 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.300 }
	}
}

tv_wonder_mechanics_apply_base_modifier_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 1 }
		if = { limit = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= 1 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_level_1 years = -1 mode = add_and_extend } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= 2 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_level_2 years = -1 mode = add_and_extend } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= 3 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_level_3 years = -1 mode = add_and_extend } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= 4 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_level_4 years = -1 mode = add_and_extend } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= 5 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_level_5 years = -1 mode = add_and_extend } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= 6 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_level_6 years = -1 mode = add_and_extend } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 2 }
		if = { limit = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= 1 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_triumphal_axis_level_1 years = -1 mode = add_and_extend } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= 2 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_triumphal_axis_level_2 years = -1 mode = add_and_extend } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= 3 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_triumphal_axis_level_3 years = -1 mode = add_and_extend } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= 4 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_triumphal_axis_level_4 years = -1 mode = add_and_extend } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= 5 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_triumphal_axis_level_5 years = -1 mode = add_and_extend } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:tv_wonder_level ?= 6 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_triumphal_axis_level_6 years = -1 mode = add_and_extend } }
	}

tv_wonder_mechanics_broadcast_completion_event_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 1 }
		save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_sacred_mountain
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 2 }
		save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_triumphal_axis
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 3 }
		save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_great_port
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 4 }
		save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_giant_necropolis
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 5 }
		save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_great_lighthouse
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 6 }
		save_scope_as = tv_wonder_completed_hydraulic_workshop
	}

		limit = { tv_wonder_ceremony_ready_for_confirmation_trigger = yes }
